subject.title: ci(swift): enforce shared OpenClawKit dead-code coverage

question: May this PR treat the removed and internalized OpenClawKit declarations as unsupported internal source surface once the exact-head shared Periphery workflow passes?
rationale: Repository-only scans prove the current iOS and macOS consumers do not use these declarations, but they cannot determine whether the explicitly source-compatible public APIs are an intended external or upgrade contract.

options.title: Accept internal-only contract
options.body: After the exact-head workflow passes, merge the cleanup on the explicit basis that OpenClawKit has no supported out-of-repository source consumers.

options.title: Preserve compatibility seams
options.body: Keep or annotate compatibility overloads and public construction APIs that remain supported, while landing the shared dead-code gate separately.

recommendation.title: Accept internal-only contract
recommendation.body: After the exact-head workflow passes, merge the cleanup on the explicit basis that OpenClawKit has no supported out-of-repository source consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository identifies @steipete as lead maintainer and the branch originates from their Apple CI and shared-kit work.
